check_website_access: check whether a URL is allowed by the website blocklist policy and return block metadata if blocked
load_website_blocklist: load and return the parsed website blocklist policy from config.yaml with in-memory caching
invalidate_cache: force the next website access check to re-read config instead of using cached policy
WebsitePolicyError: handle malformed website policy files by raising an exception with a descriptive error message
_iter_blocklist_file_rules: load normalized blocklist rules from a shared text file, skipping comments and blank lines
